name: pr-watch
description: Watches the PRs Claude opens: a band row with CI and merge state, merge buttons, and a nudge when one merges.

nudge.title: Nudge on merge
nudge.description: When a watched PR merges and Claude is idle, send Claude one prompt saying so.

mergeBases.title: Mergeable bases
mergeBases.description: Base branches the Merge buttons may merge into. PRs into any other base get no buttons.

hosts.title: Extra GitHub hosts
hosts.description: GitHub Enterprise hosts whose PR URLs are watched, besides github.com.
